design.description: Fifty-six machine screws and separate zinc insert envelopes replace the ordinary panel/kicker screws on the mirrored round-passage frame. Twelve attachments per face panel and four per kicker remain. The occupied insert envelopes, clearance holes and countersunk head envelopes are provisional geometry; effective thread engagement, installation details and resistance remain unqualified. Leg-bolt nuts face inward with both washers retained. Lights install after panels. Electrical mass is unknown and excluded. No historical qualification transfers.
